h: The Added Goodness of the Second Tablets

p: "And it will be, because you will hearken."
The Baal HaTurim on this parashah writes:
וְזֶהוּ בְּשָׁמְרָם עֵקֶב רָב (תְּהִלִּים יט, יב)
and this is 'in keeping them there is great reward' (Tehillim 19:12):
תִּזְכֶּה לְמָה רַב טוּבְךָ וְכוּלֵּי (שָׁם לא, כ)
you will merit 'How great is Your goodness,'" etc. (ibid. 31:20).
At first glance this is difficult:
seventeen words more than the first,
which is the numerical value of tov, "good."
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בָּבָא קַמָּא נה, א)
This follows what they said (Bava Kamma 55a):
to "the light, that it was good" (Bereishis 1:4),
that was hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
"And in the second Tablets I will give you
that is, the Torah she'b'al peh,
That is what the Baal HaTurim says:
"And this is 'in keeping them there is great reward':
"you will merit 'How great is Your goodness
that You have hidden away for those who fear You,'"
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu hid away for the tzaddikim,
and which is revealed to those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh;
the primordial light that was hidden away
And this is the aspect of the second Tablets,
שֶׁיֵּשׁ בָּהֶם גַּם הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which contain the Torah she'b'al peh as well.
"And it will be, ekev, you will hearken":
זֶה קָאֵי עַל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
this refers to the Torah she'b'al peh,
which was added in the second Tablets,
of 172 words in the first Commandments,
there were added in the second Commandments
alluding to "the light, that it was good."
That is why they are called mishpatim, ordinances:
which, had they not been said,
would have deserved to be said
and that is the reasons of the Torah,
that it means to taste the flavor
and that is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh.
And this is what they said (Pesachim 119a):
that the Ancient of Days concealed;

p: And in the commandment of the mitzvah of Shabbos,
nine words more than the first.
For the commandment of zachor in the first ones
and the commandment of shamor in the second ones
indicates "the light, that it was good,"
for with it Scripture first opened for good;
עַד וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
until "And God saw the light, that it was good,"
And it is the primordial light
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu hid away for the tzaddikim
and which is revealed to those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh.
For the main increase in Torah she'b'al peh
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
And as it is found in Pesach Eliyahu (Tikkunei Zohar, Introduction):
we call it Torah she'b'al peh."
is a remembrance of the work of Creation:
That is as they said (Tanchuma, Bereishis):
just as I rested on it."
the first heh is the aspect of Binah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנח, א)
and the tip of the yud
וְזָכַרְתָּ כִּי עֶבֶד הָיִיתָ וְגוֹמֵר (דְּבָרִים ה, טו)
"And you shall remember that you were a slave," etc. (Devarim 5:15);
so that the yetzer hara not enter the heart
so that one become, chas v'shalom, one who desecrates it.
And they no longer merited the middah of zachor,
which is "a place where there is no forgetting";
the aspect of "to make the Shabbos,"
"And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos,
That is why it says in the second Tablets:
to make the day of Shabbos."
And this is the meaning of
a remembrance of the Exodus from Egypt"
And the pasuk "And you shall remember"
"But the seventh day is Shabbos," etc.,
That is, through the aspect of shamor
just as I rested on it,"
"And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos,
corresponding to the upper and lower Shechinah," etc.,
"and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there," etc.
And in the pasuk "And they shall keep"
כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה ה׳ וְגוֹמֵר
"For in six days Hashem made," etc.;
for through "and they shall keep" one merits

p: was created with the letter tes
which indicates "the light, that it was good."
And it corresponds to the holiness of Yosef HaTzaddik,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁחָשַׁב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם קלה, א)
as corresponding to the middah of Tzaddik Yesod Olam.
As for the holy Arizal's listing
of the month of Av as corresponding to the tribe of Shimon,
according to the order of the banners,
it is along the lines of what we said
(and it was explained in Tu b'Av, maamar 6).
is the time to rectify the blemish of the serpent;
the spirit of Mashiach was born,
for then is the time of teshuvah
And then Hashem Yisbarach will in the future bring down
the Beis HaMikdash built and perfected,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב רַשִׁ״י (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ל, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
as Rashi writes (Rosh Hashanah, end of 30a).
that is, "the light, that it was good,"
And after the fifteenth of Av
we read the parashah "And it will be, because you will hearken
For on the fifteenth of the month
the moon is in its fullness;
"the light of life in every place,"
which indicates "the light, that it was good."
"And it will be, because you will hearken," etc.,
as the Baal HaTurim mentioned above alludes:
alludes to the seventeen, tov, additional words
that You have hidden away for those who fear You,"
the light that was hidden away
for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh.
"Hashem your God will keep for you
that He swore to your forefathers" (Devarim 7:12):
that you will merit the holiness of the Avos,
who are branches of the first three.
And one merits the upper Shabbos,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there,

— “And if you do obey these rules and observe them carefully, the ETERNAL your God will maintain faithfully for you the covenant made on oath with your fathers:”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Yerushalmi Kiddushin 4:1 — “… פנים דבר בריא שלא עמדו אבתיו על הר סיני. וגומלי חסדים מניין. ושמר יי אלהיך לך את הברית ואת החסד. ואילו אין בהן אחד מהן. מיד עמד וריחקן. שנאמר והגבעונים …”
